title: Unit 10 Consolidation: caudillos and personal power
goal: Review the caudillo, personal power, the montoneras, the debate over order and the legacy of caudillismo.

items: Talk about the caudillos with relative clauses, verbs with a fixed preposition, *cuando* and *mientras*, reported speech and *resultar* + adjective.
Say who Rosas, Páez and Quiroga were.
Say how a caudillo raised his forces and held his power.
Say what Sarmiento wrote and what historians say about the caudillos.
Use the words of the unit: landowner, follower, official, montonera, exiled and patronage.
